title: Customer migration checklist for air-gapped VPC with KMS key rotation and audit retention
creator: Maya Chen
description: This ticket defines a customer-facing migration checklist and coordinated launch steps for customers moving to air-gapped VPC / on-prem deployments that require KMS-managed keys, RBAC controls, and long-term audit log retention. Deliverables: 1) migration checklist doc, 2) release notes snippet, 3) operator runbook for key rotation, 4) enablement playbook for customer success and support, 5) compliance evidence templates (retention statements, encryption proof). The goal is to reduce time-to-migrate and ensure audit/compliance requirements are pre-addressed.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Checklists completed and reviewed by Security and SRE; 2) Release notes PR merged and included in private-2026.03 release notes; 3) Operator runbook validated in two internal dry-runs; 4) Training materials uploaded to Drive and at least 3 support engineers trained; 5) KMS rotation procedure verified against compliance checklist.
tasks:
- Draft end-to-end migration checklist covering preflight, networking, KMS provisioning, RBAC mapping, audit retention and oncall escalation
- Create release notes fragment and coordinate with Comms for customer-facing copy
- Author operator runbook: KMS key rotation, emergency key revocation, audit log archival
- Produce enablement slide deck and short demo video (5-7min)
- Schedule 2 dry-run migrations with Solutions Eng and SRE
- File compliance artifacts and map to SOC/ISO controls
- Update Console docs to include RBAC and audit retention options
- Coordinate support playbook and triage flow for migration issues
stakeholders: Product: Priya Nambiar; Security: Lars Becker; SRE: Aisha Patel; Solutions Eng: Daniel Ortiz; Docs: Nina Park; Support Lead: Omar Ruiz; Legal: Elena Volkova
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal readiness): complete checklist and two dry-runs (by 2026-03-18). Phase 2 (beta customers): pilot with 2 customers, collect feedback, adjust (2026-03-20 to 2026-03-31). Phase 3 (GA): include in private-2026.03 release, publish release notes and enablement kit, schedule office hours (by 2026-04-05).
release_notes_outline:
- Feature: Air-gapped VPC migration checklist and operator runbook
- Security: KMS rotation workflows and supported key types
- Compliance: configurable audit log retention and archival guidance
- Notes: Breaking changes (none), known limitations, contact points for migration support
- Links: migration-checklist, runbook, enablement-pack
training_plan:
- 60-minute enablement session for Solutions Eng and Support (recorded)
- Hands-on dry-run with runbook for SRE engineers
- Short micro-lessons: 'KMS key lifecycle' and 'audit retention policies' (10min each)
- Publish FAQs and escalation matrix in Support Confluence page
risks_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured KMS access leading to service disruption. Mitigation: gated preflight checks, simulated rotation in dry-run, emergency rollback playbook. Risk: audit logs exceed retention budget. Mitigation: provide sizing guidance and default retention templates, and recommend archival to customer S3. Risk: RBAC mapping misalignment. Mitigation: provide mapping templates and validation scripts.
